exercise_details_dialog.title: Plank Exercise
exercise_details_dialog.step_1: Lie on your stomach on an exercise mat, placing elbows directly under shoulders.
exercise_details_dialog.step_2: Rest on your toes and lift your body off the floor.
exercise_details_dialog.step_3: Keep a straight line from head to heels.
exercise_details_dialog.step_4: Tighten abs and glutes to prevent dropping or lifting hips.
exercise_details_dialog.step_5: Keep neck in neutral position, head in line with body.
exercise_details_dialog.step_6: Breathe regularly, do not hold breath while holding. Slowly return to start.
exercise_details_dialog.rep_3: Reps: 3-5 times based on fitness level.
exercise_details_dialog.warn_1: Avoid straining neck forward or backward, keep natural head position.
exercise_details_dialog.warn_2: If you feel back pain, stop immediately and review form.
exercise_details_dialog.warn_3: Can be modified for beginners by resting on knees instead of toes.
exercise_details_dialog.warn_4: Do not let hips drop down, causes lower back pain.

challenges.no_active_desc: You can design your own challenge, or join one of the public challenges and compete with other subscribers to reach your goal faster and with more motivation!
challenges.description_body: Challenge yourself today and walk 15,000 steps! This challenge helps you increase your daily activity, improve your physical health, and burn calories in a fun and easy way. Step by step, you will feel energetic and vital throughout the day.
challenges.rule_1: Start now — every step counts from the moment you begin the challenge.
challenges.rule_2: Track your steps using your phone or smartwatch.
challenges.rule_3: Short rest breaks are allowed; what matters is reaching the final goal.
challenges.rule_4: Once you reach 15,000 steps, you'll earn: You completed today's walking challenge!
challenges.rule_5: If you complete the challenge 2 days in a row, you get double points.
